Package dev.turboism.sdk.config

Interface PluginConfigRegistry

All Known Implementing Classes:
PluginConfigRegistry.Unavailable
public interface PluginConfigRegistry
A plugin's access to its own configuration, both the untyped string API and the typed schema API.

Reads and writes are permission-scoped: readScope(java.lang.String) and writeScope(java.lang.String) declare the paths a plugin intends to touch. The typed methods (registerSchema(dev.turboism.sdk.config.ConfigSchema, java.util.List<dev.turboism.sdk.config.ConfigMigration>), read(dev.turboism.sdk.config.ConfigKey<T>), write(dev.turboism.sdk.config.ConfigKey<T>, T, long)) are optional and default to throwing UnsupportedOperationException, so an implementation that predates the typed config feature remains valid.

    • registerUserEditableSchema

      default CompletionStage<Void> registerUserEditableSchema(ConfigSchema schema, List<ConfigMigration> migrations, ConfigSchemaEditor editor)
      Registers a typed schema and explicitly opts selected scalar keys into the shared settings UI.

      The default preserves compatibility with hosts that support typed configuration but do not yet render config editors: the schema is still registered, while the presentation metadata is ignored. Runtimes with editor support validate the metadata before publishing either surface.

      Parameters:
      schema - typed configuration schema
      migrations - complete migration chain for the schema
      editor - explicit user-editable field metadata
      Returns:
      completion of schema registration and, when supported, settings publication
